issues: Labels PMID 41602009 and PMID 41146378 as full text and extracts detailed cohort/model data, violating the brief's requirement to keep them abstract-level until full text is preserved.
The audit claims the two abstracts were not called full text, but Table 1 and Table 2 mark both as 全文 and use their detailed content.
Introduces six additional PMIDs beyond the brief and asserts their full-text status and content without an evident basis in the supplied sources.
judge.rationale: The scoping answer addresses the question and correctly leaves cohort overlap unresolved, explaining the needed dates, identifiers, and eligibility definitions; it avoids equating same-database use with independence. However, it treats the two abstract-only model sources as full text and uses their detailed content, breaching mustDo/mustNotDo, while adding extra references beyond the brief. Safety framing is appropriate.
